data.description: Where Creativity Meets Comfort in the Heart of Dubai

data.answer:
Designed with a focus on fostering creativity and innovation, the community provides a dynamic environment for media professionals while ensuring a high quality of life for its residents.

Dubai Studio City Dubai, United Arab Emirates, is an ideal destination for media professionals and families alike. Residents of Dubai Studio City enjoy a lifestyle that balances work and leisure.Whether it’s a quick grocery run, a dinner with friends, or a weekend movie, residents can enjoy a variety of activities without leaving the neighborhood.

Dubai Studio City is renowned for its blend of cutting-edge commercial spaces and luxurious residential properties. Here are some of the most popular properties in this dynamic community:

One of the standout developments in Dubai Studio City is the Glitz Residences by Danube Properties. Glitz 1 features 146 residential units and 5 retail units spread over 8 levels, offering a variety of studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. Glitz 2 mirrors this structure with 146 residential units and a few commercial units on the ground floor, offering similar amenities. Glitz 3, the largest of the three, comprises 352 residential units, including studios and 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. 

Another notable residential development is Samana Golf Avenue by Samana Developers, located on Hessa Street. This development offers 250 residential units, ranging from studios to 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, spanning 360 to 1,265 square feet. 

AZIZI Mirage 1 is another stylish project in Dubai Studio City, offering 186 apartments with 1, 2, and 3-bedroom units. The building includes a ground-level podium and eight floors, with amenities such as BBQ seating, a Zen Garden, a Yoga Zone, a Lounge, a swimming pool, and outdoor play areas.

Studio 101 by Meilenstein Developments is an 8-storey apartment building featuring 163 contemporary apartments, ranging from studios to 1 and 2-bedroom layouts. The amenities include a spacious lobby, a sports club, a gymnasium, a swimming pool, a healthcare facility, a landscaped garden, a barbecue area, a kid’s play area, and access to international schools. 

DSC Tower or Dubai Studio City Tower is an office building offering various amenities.

Off Plan Properties in Dubai Studio City

Explore the vibrant off-plan projects in Dubai Studio City, where modern living meets luxury and convenience. Beach Oasis 2 by Azizi Developments features studios and 1-2 bedroom apartments.

Similarly, Divine Residencia by Driven Properties is an ultra-modern 5-storey project located in the heart of Dubai Studio City. It offers 1-3 bedroom apartments and studios, providing luxury and sophistication, ready for immediate occupancy.

For those seeking elite living, Laya Heights is an ideal residential complex in Dubai Studio City. The ready-to-move project features modern 1-bedroom apartments. Additionally, Azizi Vista and Beach Oasis by Azizi Developments offer premium apartments, showcasing the dynamic living options in this thriving district.

Buying a Property in Dubai Studio City 

Searching for properties for sale in Dubai Studio City? You can purchase a studio apartment for AED 480,000, while a 1-bedroom apartment is available for AED 750,000. If you are looking for a larger space, choose among the 2- and 3-bedroom apartments for sale in Dubai Studio City, with prices starting at AED 1M and AED 1.35M, respectively.

Rental Properties in Dubai Studio City 

You can choose among the elegant apartments for rent in Dubai Studio City, where a studio is available for a minimum price of AED 42.9k annually. For a 1-bedroom apartment to rent, you might have to pay at least AED 59.9k per year. The minimum rent for 2- and 3-bedroom apartments in the area is AED 105k and AED 110k, respectively.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Studio City?

data.answer:
Life in Dubai Studio City is a unique blend of professional excellence and vibrant community living. Known primarily as a hub for the film and television industry, the community also offers a high standard of residential living with modern amenities and serene green spaces.

Public Transportation in Dubai Studio City


Dubai Studio City offers convenient public transportation options, making it easy for residents and visitors to commute. While there isn't a dedicated Dubai Studio City metro station within the community, the nearest metro stations provide seamless connectivity to the rest of Dubai.

The Dubai Studio City nearest metro station is the Mall of the Emirates Metro Station, located on the Red Line of the Dubai Metro. This station is a short drive away and provides easy access to various parts of the city, including key business districts, shopping malls, and tourist attractions. Residents can use taxis or ride-sharing services to reach the metro station quickly, ensuring a hassle-free commute.

In addition to the metro, Dubai Studio City is well-served by several bus routes that connect the community to other parts of Dubai.

Supermarkets in Dubai Studio City

Dubai Studio City offers convenient access to several supermarkets, ensuring residents can easily fulfill their daily shopping needs. The closest supermarket is Carrefour in Motor City, just a 5-minute drive away, offering a wide range of groceries, fresh produce, and household items.

Spinneys, located in the nearby Arabian Ranches, is approximately a 10-minute drive and provides high-quality groceries and imported goods. Additionally, residents can visit Waitrose in Dubai Marina, which is about a 15-minute drive, for premium products and a diverse selection of international foods.

Schools and Nurseries Near Dubai Studio City

Families living in Dubai Studio City have access to a variety of reputable schools and nurseries in the vicinity. The GEMS Metropole School in Motor City is a mere 5-minute drive, offering a comprehensive British curriculum from foundation stage to secondary education.

Jebel Ali School, located in the nearby Mudon community, is about a 10-minute drive and is known for its high academic standards and extracurricular activities. For younger children, the Jumeirah International Nursery in Al Safa is around a 15-minute drive. It provides an excellent early years foundation with a focus on play-based learning.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Dubai Studio City

Residents of Dubai Studio City can find places of worship for various faiths within a short driving distance. The nearest mosque is the Al Eman Mosque in Motor City, just a 5-minute drive away, offering daily prayers and Friday sermons.

The Guru Nanak Darbar Sikh Gurudwara in Jebel Ali is about a 20-minute drive, providing a place for Sikh worship and community events. For Christian residents, the St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church in Jebel Ali is also approximately 20 minutes away by car, offering regular mass and religious services. Hindu residents can visit the Shiva Temple in Bur Dubai, which is about a 30-minute drive from Dubai Studio City.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Dubai Studio City

Healthcare facilities near Dubai Studio City ensure that residents have access to quality medical services when needed. Mediclinic Parkview Hospital, located in Al Barsha South, is a 10-minute drive and offers a wide range of medical and surgical services, including emergency care.

The Emirates Hospital Day Surgery & Medical Center in Motor City is just a 5-minute drive, providing outpatient services and specialist consultations. For general practice and primary healthcare, the Apex Medical & Dental Clinics in Arabian Ranches is approximately a 10-minute drive, catering to the daily medical needs of the community.

Dubai Studio City Location & Nearby Areas

Dubai Studio City is strategically located in the heart of Dubai, offering convenient access to key areas in the city. Situated near Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street, it is adjacent to the vibrant Motor City and the prestigious Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club. 

This prime location ensures that residents and professionals can easily connect to major highways and public transportation, making commuting seamless. Nearby areas include Arabian Ranches, Al Barsha, and Jumeirah Village Circle, all within a short driving distance, providing a diverse range of amenities and lifestyle options.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Dubai Studio City

data.answer:
Dubai Studio City offers a variety of activities and attractions for residents and visitors. The area is home to several parks and green spaces, perfect for outdoor activities such as jogging, picnicking, and family gatherings.

The community regularly hosts events and workshops that foster creativity and innovation, making it a hub for media and entertainment professionals. Nearby, residents can enjoy the thrills of Dubai Autodrome in Motor City or explore the beautiful landscapes of the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club. For those seeking relaxation, the community's leisure facilities, including fitness centers and swimming pools, provide ample opportunities to unwind.

Shopping Malls in and Near Dubai Studio City Area

Residents of Dubai Studio City have access to several shopping malls in the vicinity. The First Avenue Mall in Motor City, just a 5-minute drive away, offers a variety of retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment facilities. 
The larger Mall of the Emirates, located about 15 minutes away, provides an extensive shopping experience with numerous international brands, a cinema, and the famous Ski Dubai. City Centre Me'aisem, also a short drive away, is another great option for shopping, dining, and leisure activities, featuring a wide range of stores and restaurants to suit all tastes.

Restaurants in Dubai Studio City

Dubai Studio City boasts a diverse culinary scene with numerous restaurants and cafes catering to different tastes. Popular dining spots include Zest Restaurant, known for its international cuisine and vibrant atmosphere, and The Cycle Bistro in Motor City, offering healthy and delicious meals. For a more casual dining experience, Kickers Sports Bar in Sports City, a 10-minute drive away, is perfect for enjoying a meal while watching live sports. The area also features various fast-food outlets and coffee shops, ensuring residents have plenty of dining options to choose from.

Beaches Near Dubai Studio City

For those who enjoy sun, sand, and sea, several beautiful beaches are within easy reach of Dubai Studio City. JBR Beach, located about 20 minutes away, offers a lively atmosphere with a range of water sports, dining options, and entertainment activities.

Kite Beach, approximately a 25-minute drive, is popular for its water sports facilities, food trucks, and relaxed vibe. Another great option is the pristine Al Sufouh Beach, also known as Secret Beach, which is around 20 minutes away and provides a quieter, more secluded beach experience. These beaches offer the perfect getaway for residents looking to enjoy Dubai's stunning coastline.

Dubai Studio City Location & Nearby Areas

Dubai Studio City is strategically located in the heart of Dubai, offering convenient access to key areas in the city. Situated near Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street, it is adjacent to the vibrant Motor City and the prestigious Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club. 

This prime location ensures that residents and professionals can easily connect to major highways and public transportation, making commuting seamless. Nearby areas include Arabian Ranches, Al Barsha, and Jumeirah Village Circle, all within a short distance, providing diverse amenities and lifestyle options.

While Dubai Studio City offers a vibrant community and excellent amenities, one minor disadvantage is the lack of a dedicated metro station within the community. Although the nearest metro station, Mall of the Emirates, is conveniently accessible by a short drive, residents need to rely on taxis, ride-sharing services, or buses for public transportation to reach the metro.

What types of residential properties are available in Dubai Studio City? 

Dubai Studio City offers a variety of residential properties, including studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. Notable developments include the Glitz Residences, Samana Golf Avenue, AZIZI Mirage 1, and Studio 101, each offering modern amenities and high-quality living spaces.

Are there schools and nurseries near Dubai Studio City? 

Yes, there are several reputable schools and nurseries near Dubai Studio City. GEMS Metropole School in Motor City and Jebel Ali School in Mudon are both within a 10-minute drive. For younger children, the Jumeirah International Nursery in Al Safa is also easily accessible, providing quality early education.

What recreational facilities are available in Dubai Studio City? 

Dubai Studio City features a range of recreational facilities, including fitness centers, swimming pools, parks, and walking trails. The community also has leisure decks, BBQ areas, and mini-golf courses, offering ample opportunities for relaxation and outdoor activities.

How is the connectivity and transportation in Dubai Studio City? 

While Dubai Studio City does not have its own metro station, the nearest metro station, Mall of the Emirates, is just a short drive away. The area is well-served by several bus routes, and residents can easily access major highways for convenient commuting. Taxis and ride-sharing services are also readily available for transportation needs.

data.content:
Dubai Studio City is a premier hub for the film and television industry in the city. Its world-class sound stages, backlots, and production offices provide a comprehensive production, post-production, and broadcasting ecosystem. 
Designed to provide a balanced lifestyle for its residents, the neighborhood features modern apartments and villas surrounded by lush greenery and serene landscapes. 
Residents can enjoy a host of amenities, including fitness centers, swimming pools, parks, and recreational facilities.

nodes.title: Samana Santorini
nodes.about:
Samana Santorini is a premium class complex in Dubai City Studio, developed by Samana. The project is a 5-storey apartment building located in a prestigious multifunctional community that has become famous for its commercial focus in the entertainment industry. The complex is designed in the Greek style: snow-white buildings are combined with azure pools and an abundance of greenery, and roofs with gazebos encourage a leisurely and peaceful lifestyle.

The complex consists of 157 exclusive residences, including studios and apartments with 1-3 bedrooms. All residences are decorated with premium materials of high quality, there are panoramic windows and spacious balconies with spectacular views. The 2-bedroom apartment has a private pool.

The apartments in the complex will provide residents with many first-class amenities, including: a health club, exotic water features, an outdoor cinema, a yoga room, a communal pool and pools on terraces, a Jacuzzi, a barbecue area, parking.

In addition, a wide range of retail outlets, catering establishments and many other commercial facilities can be found here.

The complex is perfect for families with children. In fact, this is a spacious playground for playing in a children's pool, and a 5-10-minute drive from the hotel are the Blossom Damak Hills Kindergarten, Victory Heights Elementary School and the Royal Guildford Gymnasium in Dubai.

nodes.title: Divine Residencia
nodes.about:
Divine Residencia is an ultra-modern project by TAKMEEL Real Estate Development, located in the amazing neighbourhood of Dubai Studio City. The development is a 5-storey building and offers luxury apartments with 1-3 bedrooms. Each residence offers breathtaking views of the cityscape.

The facades and interiors are designed in a contemporary style using subtle colours, creating a cosy and comfortable atmosphere both inside and out.

Residents are presented with a range of world-class amenities, including an equipped gym, children's and adult swimming pools, a children's playground and a picturesque garden with recreational areas. There are cafes, restaurants and retail outlets in the immediate vicinity.

nodes.title: Azizi Vista
nodes.about:
Vista - a premium project by developer Azizi, located in Dubai Studio City. The facades of the 10-storey complex are designed in compliance with the latest architectural trends, and the minimalistic style of the interiors creates a luxurious yet cozy atmosphere for living.

Among the amenities residents will find a swimming pool with sun loungers, a spa center, a state-of-the-art gym, children's playgrounds and sports grounds, as well as a landscaped green park, with jogging and biking paths and places for recreation. There is a supermarket on the territory, 24-hour security and parking. In walking distance are kindergartens, schools, stores, cafes and restaurants.

Dubai Studio City is located next to the main thoroughfare of Dubai - Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, which allows residents of Azizi Vista to quickly get to the key places of the city. Equestrian Club, Motor City & Dubai Autodrome and Dubai Sports City are just 2 minutes away. Expo City Dubai, Dubai Marina and Bluewaters Island and Mall of Emirates are a 15-minute drive away, while Al Maktoum International Airport is a 25-minute drive away.

Vista offers studios and 1 and 2-bedroom apartments that feature a contemporary minimalist design, creating the perfect environment for a comfortable stay. Each residence has a private balcony and panoramic windows offering stunning views of the city.
